name: sottos-payload
description: Codex plugin for the Clerk-authenticated Sottos Payload CMS MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and edit Sottos blog content through Payload MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted Sottos Payload CMS MCP server with Clerk OAuth login. Blog-safe workflow: posts, tags, categories, and media can be found, created, and updated; user-management tools are unavailable. Agents should generate cover images with their host image tool, upload them through createMedia, then create rollback-safe post drafts with SEO fields. Publishing should happen only after admin approval.
defaultPrompt: Use Sottos Payload CMS to list current blog post titles.
Generate a cover image, upload it, and create a draft Sottos blog post with tags and categories.
Update an existing Sottos blog post draft without deleting published content.
